briefing:
The Corvane warehouse automation project has a number of workstreams in motion, and this briefing pulls together the latest status updates and emails. The plan provides for 45 picking robots, and the switch to automated picking is planned for Friday 3 September 2027. Aisling Sørensen owns the robot procurement workstream, while Corentin Whitfield owns the floor reinforcement workstream. Late delivery of charging stations could delay the switch to automated picking.

On the floor reinforcement side, the work is scheduled to end on Thursday 1 April 2027. Working days are Monday to Friday, and there are no public holidays in this period. A failed load test on the mezzanine could delay the switch to automated picking.

Robot installation can begin 10 working days after the floor reinforcement work ends. That sequencing links the reinforcement workstream directly to procurement, since the robots Aisling Sørensen is responsible for cannot be installed until the floor is complete. In March, an additional 3 picking robots were approved, and that approval sits alongside the 45 picking robots the plan provides for. Higher electricity costs could affect the budget. All sign-offs, handovers, deliveries and meetings in this note take place on working days.

On budget, the approved project budget is €344,000. The steering group approved an increase of €49,000 to the project budget in March. The quarterly budget review is on Tuesday 6 July 2027, and that is the next scheduled point at which the figures will be looked at formally. The maintenance contract is worth €41,000, and Emeka Okafor owns the maintenance contracts workstream. The figure of €344,000 is the budget as first approved, before the changes listed in this note.

Two other workstreams cover people and systems. Leilani Mwangi owns the safety training workstream, and the operator training course is on Tuesday 2 March 2027. The safety committee meeting is on Wednesday 2 June 2027. Anders Kowalczyk owns the software integration workstream, which sits alongside the others as the project moves toward the planned switch to automated picking.

That covers the information received so far from each workstream owner. Further updates will be folded into later briefings as they arrive from the owners named above. Spare-part price rises could affect the number of picking robots.

briefing:

Leilani Brennan owns the building fit-out, Thandiwe Okafor owns equipment procurement, Dmitri Sørensen owns clinical staffing, Kwame Whitfield owns regulatory approval, and Rohan Bakshi owns community outreach. Updates from each of them feed into this summary. Higher energy tariffs could affect the number of treatment chairs.

On the financial side, the approved project budget is €90,000. In March the steering group approved a reduction of €35,000 to the project budget. Separately, the imaging equipment lease is worth €47,500. The updates received so far do not reconcile these items with one another, and this briefing does not attempt to. The figure of €90,000 is the budget as first approved, before the changes listed in this note.

The building fit-out is scheduled to end on Monday 22 March 2027. Working days are Monday to Friday, and there are no public holidays in this period. Leilani's updates have been consistent on that end date. A backlog at the licensing authority could delay the first day of patient appointments.

Equipment installation can begin 10 working days after the building fit-out ends. Thandiwe's procurement workstream is the one that depends on that starting point, and her notes refer to the same rule as the one stated here. Late delivery of the X-ray unit could delay the first day of patient appointments. All sign-offs, handovers, deliveries and meetings in this note take place on working days.

On capacity, the plan provides for 22 treatment chairs. An additional 2 treatment chairs were approved in March, in the same month as the budget decision mentioned above. The emails received do not say more about how the two chair decisions sit alongside each other, so both are recorded as stated.

Several dated events are already fixed. Rohan has the open evening for residents on Friday 16 April 2027. The first day of patient appointments is planned for Friday 30 July 2027. Dmitri's staffing workstream includes the staff induction day on Friday 13 August 2027, and the governance board meeting follows on Tuesday 21 September 2027. A rise in insurance premiums could affect the budget.

Kwame's regulatory approval workstream runs alongside all of this, and his updates will be added to later briefings as they arrive. Further detail from each owner will be folded into the next version of this note.
